description: B5 fix-up 2 (b5-refsem.md 12.2): the 48 cp12c-probes/src cases whose NIFT_VM=1 result differs from legacy on B5. Original expectation of the target: legacy-equal under NIFT_VM=1 (tests/runtime2/cp12c_probes.py). Each entry keeps the source (sha256), the legacy result (NIFT_VM=0, B5 binary; the expectation the harness used to enforce), the 17f7964c (B4b production) NIFT_VM=1 result and outcome, the B5 result (NIFT_VM=1 and NIFT_VM=require identical), and the approved rule it is converted under: snapshot = snapshot iteration (owner 2026-11-01 "loops iterate a snapshot taken at entry", 2026-11-02 "snapshot iteration kept"; plan section 3 Iteration, D5; Q3 rows 5-6); D1 = per-iteration loop-variable binding (owner 2026-11-07 06:55 decision 1). Kept distinct.
